# UI / Design resources

> 1288 curated UI/design sources (components, galleries, design-instruction repos, fonts, icons) collected from X bookmarks. Each entry states what the resource is and the machine-readable way to pull it.

> 1391 further single-mention entries live in `catalog.json` (MCP `search_resources`).

## Components & UI kits

- [Beautiful UI](https://beautiful-ui-five.vercel.app): 27 copy-paste components for AI-native interfaces: chat, thinking states, streamed text, approval cards, tables and cards.
- [The Component Gallery](https://component.gallery): Reference of 60 interface components from 95 design systems, with 2,671 examples, names, markup and usage notes.
- [Beautiful UI](https://beautifului.dev): 27 copy-paste components for AI-native interfaces: chat, thinking states, streamed text, approval cards, tables and cards.
- [Rare UI](https://rareui.com): Registry of 24 animated React components — sidebars, drawers, an OTP input, a WebGL orb and more — installed with the shadcn CLI.
- [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com): Copy-paste React component collection and registry: 60+ accessible components, blocks, charts and a CLI.
- [Bencho](https://bencho.dev): Library of interactive React UI blocks and micro-interactions, plus 82 UI sounds and a wall of 158 interaction clips.
- [beUI](https://beui.dev): Open-source animated React and Next.js components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS, installed by copy-paste or shadcn CLI.
- [Canvas UI](https://canvasui.dev): Open source component library of WebGL and WebGPU canvas effects that run over live HTML, installed via a shadcn registry.
- [Opensource UI](https://opensourceui.in): Free MIT-licensed React and Next.js library of 207+ copy-paste components, from forms and widgets to Apple device mockups.
- [Originkit](https://originkit.dev): Free library of 250+ animated components for websites, copied as React, Next.js, Vite or Framer code or pulled in by AI agents via MCP.
- [emil-design-eng](https://ui-skills.com/skills/emilkowalski/emil-design-eng): Emil Kowalski's design-engineering skill for AI agents: UI polish, animation decisions, gestures, performance and accessibility.
- [Aceternity UI](https://ui.aceternity.com): Library of 112+ animated React components, 170 landing page blocks and 17 Next.js templates built with Tailwind CSS and Motion.
- [21st](https://21st.dev): Community registry of 12,000+ React and Tailwind components, templates and themes, installable by copy, shadcn CLI, MCP or API.
- [60fps MCP](https://60fps.design/mcp): MCP server that lets AI agents search 2,100 real iOS interactions and read the motion breakdown behind each one.
- [AICSS](https://aicss.dev): Copy-paste UI components for AI agent conversations: thinking states, tool calls, streaming text, citations and tables.
- [Amicro](https://amicro.vercel.app): React library of micro-interaction, transition and card components, added with the shadcn CLI.
- [coss ui](https://coss.com/ui): 55 accessible React components built on Base UI, documented for developers and AI agents.
- [Hover.dev](https://hover.dev): Animated, copy-paste components and page templates for React and Tailwind CSS, built with Framer Motion.
- [KokonutUI](https://kokonutui.com): Free open-source library of 100+ animated React and Tailwind CSS components, installable from a shadcn registry.
- [Magic UI](https://magicui.design): 150+ free animated React components and effects for landing pages, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion.
- [mapcn](https://mapcn.dev): Copy-paste React map components and blocks built on MapLibre GL, installed with the shadcn CLI.
- [Liquid metal](https://metal.jakubantalik.com): React component that wraps a button, chip or icon in an animated WebGL liquid-metal ring.
- [MicroKit UI](https://microkit.co): 49 free copy-paste microinteractions for React, CSS and Tailwind: animated buttons, hover effects, tabs and inputs.
- [Motion-Primitives](https://motion-primitives.com): Open-source React UI kit of 23 copy-paste animated components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS.
- [React Bits](https://reactbits.dev): Open-source library of 170+ animated React components, text animations, backgrounds and micro interactions.
- [React Vibe](https://reactvibe.com): Motion-first React components, UI blocks and dashboard systems built with Framer Motion and Tailwind.
- [Free Shadcn UI Components](https://reui.io/components): Catalog of 1241+ free shadcn/ui components and React examples for Tailwind CSS, browsable by category.
- [Svelte Animations](https://sv-animations.vercel.app): Animated Svelte 5 component library: 50+ free, open-source effects ported from Magic UI, Spell UI and Fancy Components.
- [sv-efferd.pages.dev](https://sv-efferd.pages.dev): Svelte Efferd Blocks / Marketing Blocks for Shadcn-Svelte
- [Svelte Dot Matrix Loaders](https://sv-matrix.vercel.app): 50+ free, open-source dot-matrix loaders for Svelte: animated squares, hexes, triangles and circles on a dot grid.
- [Svelte QBlocks](https://sv-particles.vercel.app): Free shadcn-svelte blocks for Svelte 5: accordions, alert dialogs, avatars, banners, buttons, inputs, menus and data tables.
- [Svelte Datatables Examples](https://sv-table.vercel.app): Svelte 5 data table components and example blocks built on TanStack Table v9: filtering, selection, pagination, column tools.
- [fixing-accessibility](https://ui-skills.com/skills/ibelick/fixing-accessibility): Agent skill that audits and fixes HTML accessibility: accessible names, keyboard access, focus, contrast and form errors.
- [make-interfaces-feel-better](https://ui-skills.com/skills/jakubkrehel/make-interfaces-feel-better): Agent skill with design engineering principles for polished interfaces: micro-interactions, motion, typography, shadows.
- [12-principles-of-animation](https://ui-skills.com/skills/raphaelsalaja/12-principles-of-animation): Agent skill that reviews web animation code against Disney's 12 animation principles adapted for interfaces.
- [shadcn](https://ui-skills.com/skills/shadcn-ui/shadcn): Agent skill for a project-aware shadcn/ui workflow: finding, adding, composing and fixing components correctly.
- [Halaska UI](https://ui.halaska.com): Single-file React UI kit for AI products: shadcn/ui-parity components plus AI UX patterns and example screens.
- [UIAble](https://uiable.com): Shadcn-based UI system with 779+ components, 393+ blocks, 6 templates and 3 admin dashboards for React and Next.js.
- [Design](https://github.com/johnson7543/design): React component that turns URLs into interactive 3D tree or city artwork that becomes a scannable QR code.
- [GPUI Kit](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit): Rust component library and desktop application framework for building cross-platform apps with GPUI.
- [GPUI Kit](https://gpui-kit.com): Rust UI framework and component library with 75+ components for building GPUI desktop apps.
- [scroll-fade](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/utils/scroll-fade): shadcn/ui utility that adds a fade effect to the edges of a scroll container.
- [pdfcn](https://pdfcn.dev): Copy-paste PDF components for React, shipped as a shadcn registry — document primitives, invoices, reports and theme presets.
- [LogoDraw](https://github.com/RhuanCruz/swiftui-logo-draw): SwiftUI component that animates a logo: it traces the outline like a pen, then reveals the fill — plus a PNG-to-Shape pipeline.
- [Sona UI](https://sona-ui.vercel.app): Animated React components — dropdowns, dialogs, tabs, tooltips, buttons — installed as source into your project through the shadcn CLI.
- [Agent Elements](https://agent-elements.21st.dev): Open-source shadcn registry of 25 React components for agent UIs: chat shell, tool call cards, streaming markdown, input controls.
- [8bitcn/ui](https://www.8bitcn.com): Retro 8-bit shadcn/ui components and blocks for React — including health bars, XP bars and game-ready pieces — plus copy-paste themes.
- [8StarLabs UI](https://ui.8starlabs.com): Custom shadcn/ui registry of niche React components: timeline, status monitor, transport badge, flip clock, heatmap, marquee, JSON viewer.
- [AdaptTable](https://github.com/orwa-mahmoud/adapttable): Headless data table for React and Angular with adapters for Mantine, MUI, Chakra, Ant Design, Radix, Base UI, shadcn/ui and unstyled HTML.
- [Agents UI](https://livekit.io/ui): Open-source React + shadcn library for LiveKit voice agents: audio visualizers, control bar, chat transcript, session view.
- [Animated Header](https://github.com/mehrdadrafiee/animated-header): Scroll-aware animated header component for Next.js, built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion, inspired by Vercel's header.
- [Animated Tabs](https://github.com/mehrdadrafiee/animated-tabs): Animated tab component for Next.js built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion, with smooth animations and hover effects.
- [approvals-ui](https://approvals-ui.vercel.app): shadcn registry of React Flow components for approval workflows: quorum gates, thresholds, policy lint and human-gated editing.
- [assistant-ui](https://github.com/Yonom/assistant-ui): Open-source TypeScript/React library of composable primitives for building AI chat interfaces.
- [audio/ui](https://github.com/ouestlabs/audio-ui): Copy-paste React components for building audio interfaces: faders, knobs, XY pads, channel strips, players and transports.
- [Autocomplete component with Shadcn UI](https://www.armand-salle.fr/post/autocomplete-select-shadcn-ui): Write-up with a live demo of a custom autocomplete select component built with shadcn/ui and Fancy Multi Select.
- [AutoForm](https://github.com/vantezzen/auto-form): React library that renders forms automatically from Zod, Yup or Joi schemas, with official shadcn/ui and MUI packages.
- [Async Select](https://async.rdsx.dev): Copy-paste async select component for React built on shadcn/ui's Popover and Command, with debounced search and a preload mode.
- [Big Calendar](https://github.com/lramos33/big-calendar): Next.js calendar app template with agenda, year, month, week and day views, drag-and-drop events and user filtering.
- [Billing SDK](https://dodopayments.com): Open-source React billing and subscription UI components from Dodo Payments: pricing tables, payment forms and usage meters.
- [billui](https://github.com/commet-labs/billui): Open-source billing UI components for React and shadcn/ui: plan cards, invoice cards, payment methods and pricing tables.
- [blocks](https://github.com/ephraimduncan/blocks): Free registry of shadcn/ui blocks for React apps: AI chat, dialogs, stats, tables, login, onboarding and more.
- [BuouUI](https://buouui.com): Tailwind CSS UI library of 100+ animated React components, landing page sections and Next.js templates, built with Framer Motion.
- [Bundui](https://bundui.io): Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui component library plus 98 prebuilt blocks for marketing, ecommerce, dashboard and real-estate pages.
- [React/ShadCN Calendar](https://github.com/charlietlamb/calendar): Full calendar component for React apps and dashboards with day, week and month views, event dialogs and a date/time picker.
- [Calendar Scheduler](https://github.com/gluer-space/calendar): Multi-timezone calendar scheduler for React with month, week, day and agenda views, availability windows and slot booking.
- [CalendarCN](https://github.com/vmnog/calendarcn): Open-source Notion Calendar-inspired calendar component for React with week view, dark mode and multiple calendars.
- [Capture-Photo](https://github.com/UretzkyZvi/capture-photo): Copy-paste React camera component for capturing photos in the browser, with a CameraProvider for camera state.
- [carouselcn](https://github.com/mnove/carouselcn): Copy-paste carousel components and examples for React and Tailwind CSS with drag, loop, vertical and autoplay modes.
- [Cascader-Shadcn](https://github.com/Ademking/cascader-shadcn): Cascading dropdown component for shadcn/ui that selects hierarchical data such as locations, categories or organizational structures.
- [Components – Chánh Đại](https://chanhdai.com/components): 42 copy-paste React components for shadcn/ui: carousels, text effects, menus, testimonials and more, installed via the shadcn CLI.
- [Clerk Elements shadcn/ui Examples (deprecated)](https://clerk.com/docs/elements/examples/shadcn-ui): Deprecated Clerk docs examples composing Clerk Elements with shadcn/ui to build custom sign-in, sign-up and OTP flows.
- [clerk-shadcn-theme](https://github.com/stormynight9/clerk-shadcn-theme): CSS theme that syncs Clerk's prebuilt components with shadcn/ui styles, with an optional dark mode setup.
- [stackzero/commerce-ui](https://github.com/stackzero-labs/ui): Copy-paste e-commerce components, blocks and examples for React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
- [Componentry](https://github.com/harshjdhv/componentry): Animated React UI components — text effects, hero backgrounds, cursor and scroll effects — installed with the shadcn CLI.
- [React Confirm Dialog](https://github.com/Aslam97/react-confirm-dialog): Promise-based confirm dialog for React, built on Radix Alert Dialog and styled with Tailwind CSS v4.
- [country-state-dropdown](https://github.com/Jayprecode/country-state-dropdown): Country and state dropdown component built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Zustand.
- [Creatorem UI](https://github.com/creatorem/ui): React components that complement shadcn/ui: tour, stepper, quick form, QR code, liquid motion.
- [Credenza](https://github.com/redpangilinan/credenza): Responsive modal for shadcn/ui: a dialog on desktop, a drawer on mobile.
- [crypto-charts](https://github.com/jstnw10/crypto-charts): Demo of shadcn/ui charts fed with free historical crypto price data from Pyth Network.
- [Cult UI](https://www.cult-ui.com): Free MIT-licensed shadcn/ui component library: 154 animated React components plus blocks, templates and an MCP server.
- [DataCommand](https://shadcn.davidsling.in/components/data-command): A data-driven command component built on shadcn/ui that adds async fetching, nested commands and instant search.
- [DateRangePicker](https://github.com/johnpolacek/date-range-picker-for-shadcn): Shadcn date range picker with preset ranges, text entry, calendar selection and date comparison.
- [Shadcn DateTime Picker](https://shadcn-datetime-picker.vercel.app): A datetime picker demo built on shadcn/ui, @daypicker/react v10 and Base UI, with 3 variants and 16+ features.
- [Date Time Range Picker](https://date-time-range-picker.vercel.app): Shadcn registry of five date and time picker components, from date input to date-time range picker.
- [Shadcn Datetime Picker](https://shadcn-datetime-picker-xi.vercel.app): Shadcn registry of three date and time pickers: datetime input, simple time picker and datetime picker.
- [Dice UI](https://github.com/sadmann7/diceui): Accessible shadcn/ui component collection: 47 copy-paste React components plus utility primitives.
- [@pierre/diffs](https://diffs.com): Open-source library for rendering code diffs on the web, built on Shiki with React and vanilla JS APIs.
- [Dot Matrix](https://dotmatrix.zzzzshawn.cloud): 55+ free dot matrix loaders for React, installed from a shadcn registry and owned as local code.
- [Shadcn/ui + Downshift Combobox](https://github.com/TheOmer77/downshift-shadcn-combobox): Combobox/autocomplete and command-palette input for React, built with shadcn/ui and Downshift's useCombobox hook.
- [shadcn/ui Resizable Sidebar](https://github.com/lumpinif/drag-to-resize-sidebar): Drag-to-resize shadcn/ui sidebar with persisted width, rail-click collapse and Cmd/Ctrl+B toggle.
- [DropDrawer](https://github.com/jiaweing/DropDrawer): Responsive shadcn/ui menu: dropdown on desktop, drawer on mobile, as a drop-in DropdownMenu replacement.
- [Eldora UI](https://eldoraui.site): 150+ free animated React components and landing-page blocks: text effects, backgrounds, globes, cards and more.
- [Emblor](https://github.com/JaleelB/emblor): Headless tag-input primitive for React: tag state, validation, keyboard and native form support.
- [enhanced-button](https://github.com/jakobhoeg/enhanced-button): Drop-in shadcn/ui button expansion adding effects like shine, gooey, ring hover and gradient slideshow.
- [eo-n/ui](https://github.com/aeonzz/eo-n): Accessible UI primitives built with shadcn styles and Base UI, installed through the shadcn CLI.
- [Extend UI](https://www.extend-ui.com): Copy-paste React components built on shadcn/ui, adding extra variants and blocks for landing pages, forms and uploads.
- [Fancy Area](https://craft.mxkaske.dev/post/fancy-area): Tutorial and code for a markdown textarea with @mention support and hover cards, like GitHub's PR comment box.
- [Fancy Box](https://craft.mxkaske.dev/post/fancy-box): shadcn/ui combobox for multi-select with label creation and editing, like GitHub's PR label selector.

- [React Fancy Switch](https://github.com/Aslam97/react-fancy-switch): Animated, accessible switch and segmented control component for React, shipped as @omit/react-fancy-switch.
- [File Uploader](https://github.com/sadmann7/file-uploader): Drag and drop file uploader for React with a reusable UploadThing hook, built on shadcn/ui and react-dropzone.
- [File Vault](https://github.com/ManishBisht777/file-vault): File upload component for React with a Cloudinary upload helper, demoed in a small Next.js app.
- [flightcn](https://flightcn.yencheng.dev): Flight visualization components for React with prebuilt map blocks, installed from a shadcn registry.
- [react-drag-card](https://github.com/nishansanjuka/react-drag-card): Reusable React component that lets a card be dragged, resized, maximized and minimized in a floating window.
- [Fluid Functionalism](https://fluid-functionalism.vercel.app): Open-source shadcn/ui-compatible components with spring physics and proximity hover, in Radix or Base UI flavors.
- [framecn](https://github.com/shadcn-labs/framecn): Video components for React built on Editframe, distributed as shadcn registry items for building videos in code.
- [Nyxb UI](https://github.com/nyxb-ui/ui): Archived component library combining shadcn/ui and MagicUI: 150+ free React components with Tailwind and Framer Motion.
- [glasscn-ui](https://github.com/itsjavi/glasscn-ui): shadcn/ui component library with glassmorphism variants, extra components and Tailwind theming, published on npm.
- [Glitchcn/ui](https://glitchcn-ui.vercel.app): Cyberpunk, terminal-styled React component library for Next.js with scanlines, glow borders and 5 themes.
- [gluestack-ui](https://gluestack.io): Copy-paste React and React Native component library styled with Tailwind CSS, for Next.js, Expo and mobile apps.
- [gooey-toast](https://goey-toast.vercel.app): Morphing blob toast notifications for React, built on Sonner with Framer Motion animations.
- [guarahooks](https://github.com/h3rmel/guarahooks): Copy-paste React hooks library with 50+ hooks, docs and a CLI installer, free and open source.
- [HextaUI](https://hextaui.com): React components, hooks and AI blocks for shadcn/ui, built on Base UI with the hard states handled.
- [Image Crop Field](https://github.com/JsCodeDevlopment/upload-crop-image): React image upload and crop field built on shadcn/ui, wrapping react-easy-crop and react-image-crop.
- [image-upload-shadcn](https://github.com/kushagrasarathe/image-upload-shadcn): Next.js image upload demo with shadcn/ui that uploads images directly to Cloudinary.

- [Joly UI](https://github.com/Johuniq/jolyui): 50+ free copy-paste React components extending shadcn/ui, with animated text effects and motion.

- [Kalyx](https://github.com/jiji-hoon96/kalyx): Headless React date pickers (date, range, time, month, year, week) using ISO 8601 UTC strings.

- [Loading UI](https://loading-ui.com): Registry of 50 copy-paste spinners, loaders and text animations for React apps, installed with the shadcn CLI.
- [LocalMode UI](https://localmode.ai): Local-first registry of 107 AI UI components and 36 blocks that run models entirely in the browser, no server or API key.
- [Lukacho UI](https://ui.lukacho.com/components): Animated React UI components for landing pages: dropdowns, tabs, charts, pricing, cursors, backgrounds.

- [Planner](https://github.com/UretzkyZvi/planner): Copy-in React scheduling component with day/week/month/year views, resource management and drag-and-drop.
- [Plate](https://github.com/udecode/plate): Open-source React rich-text editor framework: headless slate plugins, Radix primitives and shadcn/ui editor components.
- [Multi Select](https://platejs.org/docs/multi-select): Plate's rich multi-select tag editor, with fuzzy search, drag-and-drop reordering and undo/redo history.
- [ProgressButton](https://github.com/tomredman/ProgressButton): React button component that shows manual or automatic progress with success and error states, built on the shadcn/ui button.
- [ReUI](https://reui.io): Shadcn registry with 1,241 free React and Tailwind component examples, 636 pro blocks, 667 icons, 17 templates and an MCP server.

- [Watermelon UI](https://ui.watermelon.sh): Open-source React UI platform: components, animated pieces, pre-built blocks, dashboards and templates for Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
- [Componentry](https://componentry.dev): Animated React component library with editable source: text animations, scroll effects, hero backgrounds and image effects.
- [Mantine](https://mantine.dev): React component library with 120+ components and 70+ hooks, plus form, dates and charts packages and an MCP server.
- [ThreeUI Community](https://github.com/MengTo/threeui): Open-source Three.js component catalog for React: 3D components, WebGL backgrounds, hero sections, text animations and templates.
- [Shadcn UI Kit](https://shadcnuikit.com): Shadcn/ui kit of admin dashboards, 555 blocks, components, illustrations and Next.js templates, installed via a shadcn registry.
- [HeroUI](https://heroui.com): Open-source React and React Native component library built on React Aria Components and Tailwind CSS v4.
- [Simply Buttons](https://simply-buttons.vercel.app): Specimen lab of live button styles, loaders and states, searchable by name, type or motion, with copyable code.
- [Toast](https://base-ui.com/react/components/toast): Unstyled React toast component from Base UI with stacked, anchored, promise and undo toasts.
- [Community UI Components for React & Next.js](https://21st.dev/community/components): Directory of thousands of community-published React and Next.js components, blocks, shaders and hooks, browsable by category.
- [Wensity UI](https://ui.wensity.com): React and Next.js component library with animated components, section blocks, templates and a CLI, free and Pro tiers.
- [AI Agent Components · beUI](https://beui.dev/components/agents): Animated open-source React components for AI agent interfaces: prompt input, messages, streaming responses, tool calls and approvals.
- [DialKit](https://dialkit.dev): npm library that mounts live controls in a running app to tune motion, layout, color and animation timing.
- [VantaUI](https://vantaui.com): React and Next.js UI library of components, blocks, templates and Figma files, served as a shadcn registry.
- [CSSnippets](https://cssnippets.shefali.dev): Collection of copy-paste UI snippets in HTML, React, CSS and Tailwind CSS: buttons, cards, forms, toggles and more.
- [HyperUI](https://hyperui.dev): Free, open-source Tailwind CSS v4 components to copy and paste: marketing sections, application UI and neobrutalism sets.
- [UI TripleD](https://github.com/moumen-soliman/uitripled): shadcn/ui and Base UI blocks, motion components and full pages with a Landing Builder, Background Builder, Grid Generator and Framer Motion.
- [Questionnaire](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/questionnaire): A multi-step questionnaire component with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform and skippable questions.
- [TW Components](https://tailwindcomponents.com): Free community repository of 3,000+ copy-paste Tailwind CSS components and templates, tagged by type and creator.
- [moumenlab](https://github.com/moumen-soliman/lab): React and Tailwind component lab with 12 copy-paste components, each with a live demo, a blueprint and a shadcn-registry install.
- [Preline UI](https://preline.co): Open-source Tailwind CSS UI library: 1612 components and blocks, templates, plugins and a Figma design system.
- [pdfcn](https://github.com/shadcn-labs/pdfcn): Copy-paste PDF components for React: Takumi and Forme primitives, invoice and report blocks, installed with the shadcn CLI.
- [Radix UI](https://radix-ui.com): Open-source React components: unstyled accessible primitives, a styled Themes library, a 15×15 icon set and a color system.
- [React Bits Pro Roadmap](https://pro.reactbits.dev/roadmap): Public roadmap of React Bits Pro: what shipped and what is planned across components, blocks, templates and agent skills.
- [Rare UI Components](https://rareui.com/components): Index of 24 animated React components built with Tailwind and Motion, previewed on hover and installed with the shadcn CLI.
- [React Bits Components](https://reactbits.dev/get-started/index): Index of React Bits' free animated React components — text effects, backgrounds, cards and micro-interactions — with live demos.
- [React Hook Form](https://react-hook-form.com): React form library with easy validation, tiny size and no dependencies; works with native HTML inputs and UI libraries.
- [React Flow](https://reactflow.dev): MIT-licensed React library for building node-based UIs: flowcharts, diagrams, workflow and no-code editors.
- [CSS Design Awards](https://cssdesignawards.com): CSS Design Awards - Website Awards - Best Web Design Inspiration - CSS Awards

## Templates & boilerplates

## Motion & animation

- [60fps](https://60fps.design): Library of 2,100+ interaction and motion references from real mobile and web apps, with storyboards and an MCP server.
- [Transitions.dev](https://transitions.dev): Library of 43+ crafted UI transitions with copy-ready code, plus a motion skill and motion-fixing agent for coding agents.
- [Thinking orbs](https://orbs.jakubantalik.com): Animated thinking-orb loading states for AI interfaces: nine hand-tuned states on a 2D canvas, npm package thinking-orbs.
- [Kinetics](https://kinetics.colorion.co): Library of 153 spring-physics micro-interactions for web UI, each copyable as CSS, React or an AI prompt.
- [Torph](https://torph.lochie.me): Dependency-free text morphing component for React, Vue, Svelte and vanilla JS that animates text and numbers between states.
- [HyperFrames](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes): Open-source framework that renders HTML, CSS and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos.
- [Oil Motion](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-motion): Agent skill that turns an interaction idea into web animation assets — video, sprite atlas, timeline — plus runtime code.
- [Border beam](https://beam.jakubantalik.com): Animated rainbow glow that rides the border of any card, button or input; installable as the border-beam npm package.
- [Liquid Gooey](https://gooey.jakubantalik.com): Liquid effect library for React where touching pieces merge like goo and morph like jelly while text stays crisp.
- [Prompt Motion](https://prompt-motion.com): Gallery of motion videos made with Claude Opus 5.5, each shown with the prompt or skill that produced it.
- [CSS Text Effects](https://text-effects.colorion.co): Library of 114 pure-CSS text effects with copyable code, live previews and AI prompts.
- [remocn](https://remocn.dev): shadcn registry of Remotion components — animations, transitions, shaders and app-screen sims for product demo videos.
- [snapcn](https://snapcn.dev): Shadcn registry of Remotion components for React video: text animations, captions, device frames and scenes.
- [Atelier UI](https://github.com/whatisjery/atelier-ui): Motion and React Three Fiber component system for React and Next.js: WebGL galleries, cursors, scroll effects, page transitions.
- [Sora UI](https://ui.soralabs.io.vn): Copy-paste animated React components for shadcn/ui, built with Motion, GSAP and Tailwind CSS.
- [Animata](https://animata.design): 156+ animated React components — text effects, backgrounds, cards, buttons, widgets — to copy or install with the shadcn CLI.
- [Animate UI](https://animate-ui.com): Open-source distribution of animated React components, primitives and icons, installed with the shadcn CLI.
- [MotionVariants](https://github.com/chrisabdo/motionvariants): Collection of handmade Framer Motion animation variants for React and Next.js projects.
- [SmoothUI](https://smoothui.dev): 198 animated React components and 34 page blocks for shadcn/ui, installed via the shadcn CLI.
- [tailwindcss-motion](https://rombo.co/tailwind): Tailwind CSS plugin that animates any element with simple utility classes and presets instead of custom keyframes.
- [slidytabs](https://slidytabs.dev): DOM-level utility that animates shadcn Tabs with a sliding indicator, plus slider and range-slider tab modes.
- [OpenShaders](https://openshaders.com): Pre-launch home for web shaders: claim a username and browse every claimed shader in an explore gallery.
- [Anime.js](https://animejs.com): All-in-one JavaScript animation engine: one API for DOM, SVG and CSS animations, timelines, scroll and draggable elements.
- [Motion](https://motion.dev): Animation library for JavaScript, React and Vue with full docs and 470+ copy-paste animation examples.
- [LottieFiles](https://lottiefiles.com): Library of 800,000+ free and premium Lottie animations plus browser tools to create, edit, test and ship motion.
- [Explore | OpenShaders](https://openshaders.com/explore): Gallery of all 3,191 usernames claimed before OpenShaders launches, each rendered as its own one-of-one shader.
- [Mobile App Animation: 12 Patterns Every Designer Should Study](https://svgator.com/blog/ui-animation-mobile-apps-android-ios): Blog article walking through 12 mobile app animation patterns, from launch screens and onboarding to loaders, success and error states.
- [animos](https://animos.app): Ready-made motion templates that turn images or videos into design showcase videos, exported as MP4 or WebM in the browser.
- [bloub](https://bloub.vercel.app): Animated SVG avatar that morphs between 14 states, with shape, colour and expression controls and SVG, PNG, GIF and MP4 export.
- [Libraries.dev](https://libraries.dev): Seven React UI effect libraries (Beam, Orb, Avatars, Gooey, Metal, Image, Voice) installed from npm or a coding-agent prompt.
- [Annnimate](https://annnimate.com): Paid library of 115 GSAP motion components for React, Vue and HTML, each shipped on real brand work and tuned with data attributes.
- [CSS Loader Library](https://cssloaders.colorion.co): 99 pure-CSS loading spinners you click to copy, each with a ready-made prompt for a coding agent.
- [MicroInteractions UI](https://microinteractionsui.com): Library of animated React components — tabs, button, input, toggle, stepper, navbar — built with shadcn/ui, Tailwind and Motion.
- [Shader Gradient](https://shadergradient.co): Customizable 3D moving shader gradients for React, Vue, Framer and Figma, driven by props or preset URLs.
- [Mono charts (Amicro)](https://amicro.vercel.app/mono-charts): Amicro — Premium React Micro-transitions & Interaction Components
- [Animista](https://animista.net): Browser playground of 662 ready-made CSS animations you tweak and download as CSS code.
- [Storyboards](https://60fps.design/storyboards): 67 step-by-step storyboards breaking down iOS app animations and interactions, tagged by gesture, effect and element.
- [Jitter](https://jitter.video): Browser-based motion design tool: animate designs or AI-generated effects and export video, GIF or Lottie.
- [404 Animation Library](https://404.colorion.co): 42 ready-to-copy 404 page animations built with pure CSS, each with copy-paste code or an AI prompt.
- [Liquid Orb Editor](https://lersent001.github.io/orb): Real-time WebGPU liquid-glass orb editor with 13 animated presets and Web/SwiftUI code export.
- [beUI](https://beui.saura3h.xyz): Copy-paste animated React components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS, distributed through the shadcn registry.
- [Paper Shaders](https://shaders.paper.design): Ultra-fast zero-dependency shader library for React and GLSL: animated backgrounds, image filters and logo effects.
- [TheMicro](https://the-micro.vercel.app): TheMicro
- [Raylight](https://raylight.app): Browser studio for making product launch and demo videos from screenshots: design shots on a canvas, animate on a timeline, export MP4.

## Design rules for AI

- [Refero Styles](https://styles.refero.design): Library of 2,000+ AI-readable DESIGN.md style records from real product websites, with colors, typography and spacing.
- [Diagram Design](https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design): Agent skill that draws editorial diagrams as self-contained HTML + SVG in your brand; 44 diagram types, no build step.
- [DESIGNMD](https://design-md.hyperbrowser.ai): Extracts a DESIGN.md from any website, following Google's open DESIGN.md standard.
- [DesignMD](https://designmd.me): Paste a URL and get a DESIGN.md with measured colour roles, type scale, spacing, radii, component styles and breakpoints.
- [designmd.supply](https://designmd.supply): Design Resources
- [typeui.sh](https://typeui.sh): extract straight from a live site
- [UI Skills](https://ui-skills.com): Curated catalog of 349 installable agent skills for design engineering: accessibility, motion, UI quality and frontend craft.
- [Taste Skill](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill): Portable agent skills that upgrade AI-built interfaces: layout, typography, motion and spacing rules plus image-generation skills.
- [Hallmark](https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark): Design skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex that builds UI from 21 themes and 57 anti-slop checks.
- [UI UX Pro Max](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill): Agent skill that generates a tailored design system — styles, palettes, fonts and UX rules — before UI code is written.
- [Impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable): Design guidance for AI coding agents: one skill, 23 commands, live browser iteration and 61 detector rules against AI slop.
- [Design System Checklist](https://designsystemchecklist.com): Open-source checklist site for planning, building and growing a design system.
- [UI Rules](https://uirules.com): Workspace that stores your brand's design rules and tokens and serves them to AI coding tools over MCP.
- [AI Design Skills](https://github.com/elayadesign/ai-design-skills): A growing collection of design skills for AI coding tools; the first is a landing-page system with structure and visual rules.
- [antislop](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop): Rules that stop AI coding agents from producing generic AI-slop UI, copy and code comments — a filter, not a style guide.
- [Refactoring UI (Claude Code skill)](https://github.com/s0xDk/refactoring-ui-skill): Claude Code skill that applies Refactoring UI's spacing, type, color and shadow rules when styling or reviewing UI.
- [IP as Logo](https://github.com/s1dashu/ip-as-logo-skill): Agent skill that writes image-generation prompts for simple, cute IP mascot characters.
- [ui.sh](https://ui.sh): Collection of task-oriented agent skills for building UI: design, ideas, brand kit, componentize, dark mode and responsive workflows.
- [StyleSeed](https://github.com/bitjaru/styleseed): Agent skill pack that turns recorded design decisions into project-local rules and a scored quality gate for coding agents.
- [Memi](https://github.com/sarveshsea/memi): CLI, agent skills and CI gate that audit a frontend for design-system and accessibility issues before agents edit it.
- [skills.sh](https://skills.sh): Directory of installable AI agent skills, ranked by install counts with source repos and security audits.
- [UI Playbook](https://uiplaybook.dev): Documented collection of 10 common UI components with functionality, best practices, accessibility and implementation notes.
- [Design Patterns Catalogue](https://catalogue.projectsbyif.com): Catalogue of 67 design patterns for building trusted services, from sign-in and consent to responsible AI.
- [Design.md Store](https://designmd-store.com): Library of 51+ free DESIGN.md design-system files (YAML tokens + usage rules) for AI coding assistants.
- [@shadcn/lint](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/lint): Agent-first linter that enforces Tailwind design system rules and hands coding agents fixes from your theme.
- [DESIGNmd](https://designmd.ai): Library of 400+ free DESIGN.md design systems that AI coding tools read to build consistent, on-brand UI.
- [Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines): Apple's guidance and best practices for designing a great experience on any Apple platform.

## Fonts & typography

- [UNCUT.wtf](https://uncut.wtf): Free typeface catalogue of 163 contemporary fonts in sans serif, serif, monospace and display.

- [Collletttivo](https://collletttivo.it): Open-source type foundry with 16 libre typefaces, free under the SIL Open Font License.
- [fontain](https://fontain.org): A font collection-system serving free/libre/open-source fonts with sources, webfonts and LaTeX formats.
- [Fontshare](https://fontshare.com): Free fonts service from the Indian Type Foundry (ITF), with a catalogue of 100 typefaces.
- [indestructible type*](https://indestructibletype.com): Independent foundry by Owen Earl making free typefaces such as Jost*, plus pay-what-you-want variable versions.
- [Open Foundry](https://open-foundry.com): Curated showcase of open-source typefaces with specimens, licence details and links to project pages.
- [Supa Fonts](https://supafonts.com): Free font library with per-font downloads and generator pages for previewing text in each font.
- [The League of Moveable Type](https://theleagueofmoveabletype.com): The first open-source font foundry: 18 fonts free under the Open Font License, plus type education.
- [tunera.xyz](https://tunera.xyz): tunera.xyz
- [Typehug](https://typehug.aliszu.com): Tool and npm package that adds nonbreaking spaces to English and Polish text.
- [Use & Modify](https://usemodify.com): Hand-picked collection of 191 libre and open-source fonts, browsable by license, author and keyword.
- [velvetyne.fr](https://velvetyne.fr): Home - Velvetyne
- [UI Fonts](https://www.uifonts.app): Browser tool for previewing fonts and pairings in real time, with typography guides and showcase examples.
- [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com): Library for browsing font families, with the Material Symbols icon font and typography knowledge articles.
- [Fontpair](https://fontpair.co): Font pairing tool: browse and preview 1,000+ curated Google Font combinations with your own content.
- [Fontjoy](https://fontjoy.com): One-click font pairing generator that uses deep-learning font vectors to suggest heading and body fonts.
- [Fonts In Use](https://fontsinuse.com): Searchable archive of 34,773 typographic designs, each documented with images and indexed by typeface, format and topic.
- [Font Squirrel](https://fontsquirrel.com): Library of free fonts verified for commercial use, with webfont generator and font identifier tools.
- [Typescale](https://type-scale.com): Typography scale generator: set font size, modular scale and responsive options, then copy the CSS.
- [WhatFontIs](https://whatfontis.com): Font finder: upload an image of text and AI matches it against 1.2M+ free and commercial fonts.
- [Typewolf](https://typewolf.com): Typography resource with font lists, pairings, free alternatives and a daily showcase of fonts used on real websites.
- [Manrope](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Manrope): Google Fonts specimen page for Manrope, an open-source modern sans-serif font family designed by Mikhail Sharanda in 2018.

- [shadcn/ui Components Manager](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/23479-shadcn-ui-components-manager): JetBrains IDE plugin to add, remove and update shadcn/ui components in Svelte, React, Vue and Solid projects.

- [shadcn/ui snippets](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=VeroXyle.shadcn-ui-snippets): Deprecated VS Code snippet extension for importing and using shadcn-ui components in JSX/TSX files.
- [shadcn/vue](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=Selemondev.shadcn-vue): VS Code extension that installs shadcn-vue components and adds cn/cni/cnx snippet completions in Vue files.
- [BentoHub](https://github.com/amittam104/BentoHub): App that builds a bento grid for your GitHub profile readme and exports it as HTML or Markdown.
- [Shadcn UI Cheatsheet](https://shadcnstore.com/cheatsheet): Reference page with every shadcn/ui component, its exact npx shadcn@latest add install command and what each is for.
- [country-data-in-charts](https://globe-graph.vercel.app): Globe Graph is a web app that visualizes countries' data like GDP, GDP per capita, and population in different years using many charts.
- [focus-brew](https://focusbrew.vercel.app): A free productivity toolkit that combines essential tools to help you stay focused, organized, and efficient throughout your workday.
- [FormBuilder](https://github.com/AlandSleman/FormBuilder): Visual drag-and-drop builder that generates type-safe shadcn/ui form code for Next.js, Vue and Svelte.
- [Graphitup Tools](https://graphitup.com/tools): Free no-signup online chart makers: line, bar, pie, donut, bubble, scatter, area, gauge, radar and an AI graph maker.
- [img2m3](https://img2m3.vercel.app/studio): Shadcn UI theme generator that extracts a Material Design 3 color scheme from any image and outputs Tailwind CSS v4 code.
- [imgsrc](https://imgsrc.io): Open Graph image generator: pick a template, customize the properties and export a PNG, plus an API for bulk generation.
- [PageGen](https://pagegen.ai): AI page generator that turns text, screenshots or templates into React, Tailwind and shadcn/ui pages with live preview.
- [pictera](https://pictera.co): Generate Open Graph images without design skills.
- [shadcn/ui CLI Builder](https://shadcn-easy-install.vercel.app): Web builder that generates one shadcn CLI command to install any selection of shadcn/ui components.
- [Shadcn Play](https://github.com/ephraimduncan/shadcn-play): Browser playground for shadcn/ui components: write JSX with Tailwind classes, see instant previews and share creations.
- [shadcnpreset](https://shadcnpreset.com): AI-powered browser for shadcn presets: describe a vibe, preview presets on real components, build pages and copy code.
- [Pricing page generator](https://shipixen.com/shadcn-pricing-page): Configurator that generates pricing page code for Shadcn UI, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, Next.js/Shipixen or Vue projects.
- [Shadcn Theme Editor](https://shadcnthemeeditor.vercel.app): Component and demo for editing shadcn/ui theme colors with a live preview of components and text styles.
- [shadcn-zod-form](https://github.com/ilyichv/shadcn-zod-form): CLI that converts Zod schemas into shadcn/ui forms, mapping each Zod type to the matching form component.
- [TanCN](https://tancn.dev): Drag-and-drop builder that generates type-safe TanStack Form and Table code with ShadCN UI components.
- [tinte](https://tinte.railly.dev): CLI and web tool that extracts a design system from a live site and compiles it into an Agent Plugin plus editor and terminal themes.
- [UI Builder](https://github.com/olliethedev/ui-builder): Drop-in Figma-style visual editor that lets non-developers compose pages from your React components, saved as JSON.
- [Canva](https://canva.com): Online design and publishing tool: make social posts, presentations, videos, print and websites from templates.

- [Framer](https://framer.com): AI website builder that designs and publishes sites on a visual canvas with CMS, SEO and hosting built in.
- [Vizcom](https://vizcom.ai): AI design tool that turns sketches into photorealistic 3D product renders, with prompt-based iteration and animation.
- [Figma](https://figma.com): Collaborative browser-based design canvas for UI, prototyping, whiteboarding, slides and developer handoff, with AI agent features.

## Reading & learning

- [You Don't Need Animations](https://emilkowal.ski/ui/you-dont-need-animations): Essay on when UI animations help and when they hurt, with live demos of timing, frequency and perceived speed trade-offs.
- [OpenStax](https://openstax.org): Site offering free college textbooks for students, browsable by subject.
- [Claude Design](https://ruben.substack.com/p/claude-design): Newsletter guide to Claude Design: how to access it, quick tests, the video hack for slides and how to copy any design.
- [Claude Skills](https://ruben.substack.com/p/claude-skills): Newsletter guide to Claude Skills: what they are, how to build your first skill, team skills and seven skills hacks.
- [being good at ai is (stupidly) simple](https://ruben.substack.com/p/s): Beginner's survival guide to AI, written like IKEA instructions: pick the smart model and let the AI ask you questions.
- [Claude for teams](https://ruben.substack.com/p/claude-for-teams): Step-by-step playbook for rolling out Claude across a team in one week, from Projects and prompt templates to company-wide adoption.
- [Cowork](https://ruben.substack.com/p/claude-cowork): Step-by-step guide to setting up and using Claude Cowork, from plugins and connectors to a first 30-minute walkthrough.
- [Claude For Dummies](https://ruben.substack.com/p/claude-for-dummies): Beginner's guide to Claude for people who never used it: what it is, how it compares to ChatGPT and what to try first.
- [How to stop hitting Claude usage limits](https://ruben.substack.com/p/how-to-stop-hitting-claude-usage): 23 tips for using Claude more cheaply and staying under usage limits, from token-counting habits to Claude Code settings.
- [Claude Connectors](https://ruben.substack.com/p/claude-connectors): Guide to Claude Connectors: connecting apps like Gmail and Slack, nine favorite connectors, the full list and building your own.
- [Prompting is the worst way to use Claude.](https://ruben.substack.com/p/stop-prompting-claude): Why one-shot prompts give average results, and how to give Claude persistent context via Claude Cowork, Obsidian and a SKILLS folder.
- [I can be you.](https://ruben.substack.com/p/youre-just-a-text-file): Guide to capturing your voice, taste and patterns in one text file you upload to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any AI so it writes like you.
- [Vibecoding.](https://ruben.substack.com/p/the-claude-code-bible): Guide to vibecoding with Claude Code for non-coders: setup, a copy-paste mega prompt, costs, a best-of prompt list and when not to use it.
- [Prompt 4.7](https://ruben.substack.com/p/prompt-47): Condensed version of Anthropic's 31-page prompting guide for Claude Opus 4.7: how to prompt the new Claude and how not to.
- [Stop learning Excel.](https://ruben.substack.com/p/how-to-make-perfect-spreadsheets): Guide comparing AI tools for building and editing Excel spreadsheets — Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, Shortcut.ai — with step-by-step screenshots.
- [Stop using your own Claude at work.](https://ruben.substack.com/p/how-to-use-your-personal-ai-at-work): Guide to using a personal AI account for work safely: switching off training, anonymizing data, temporary chats and the legal risks.
- [It's not [X], it's [Y].](https://ruben.substack.com/p/its-not-x-its-y): How the 'it's not X, it's Y' negative-parallelism pattern gives AI writing away, plus an anti-AI style file to drop into Claude Cowork.
- [Certified.](https://ruben.substack.com/p/im-claude-certified): How to get the three free Anthropic Claude certifications — and add them to LinkedIn — while avoiding paid certificate scams.
- [Can you detect AI?](https://ruben.substack.com/p/how-to-bypass-ai-detectors): Paid newsletter post on how Substack's AI detector works and how to write so your text does not read as AI.
- [Claude + Linkedin.](https://ruben.substack.com/p/claude-linkedin): Guide to training Claude on your LinkedIn posts and turning your own writing style into a reusable skill.

## shadcn registries

- [Payload Components](https://www.payload-components.xyz): MIT registry and CLI that installs typed Payload CMS blocks, fully wired into Payload v3 + Next.js projects.
- [shadcn.io](https://shadcn.io): Library of 6,000+ shadcn/ui blocks and components, with 285k+ React icons, themes, templates and an MCP server.
- [Shadcn Space](https://github.com/shadcnspace/shadcnspace): Open-source shadcn/ui component, block and template registry for React and Next.js projects.
- [WDS Shadcn Registry](https://wds-shadcn-registry.netlify.app): Shadcn registry of five accessible React components: action button, loading swap, multi-select, number input, password input.
- [1st-Pouf](https://1st-pouf.worksonmy.dev): Claymorphism React UI kit with 38 components, 14 blocks and 14 templates, installed shadcn-style.
- [7Ovr](https://7ovr.com): 589 shadcn/ui blocks and templates on Base UI — 243 free, the rest Pro — installed with the shadcn CLI.
- [dominik-ui](https://dominikkoch.dev/ui): Personal shadcn registry of opinionated React components for AI apps: tabs, command palette and a loader.
- [Efferd](http://efferd.com): 231 shadcn/ui blocks for marketing and app UIs — auth, hero, CTA, pricing, dashboard — free set plus one-time Pro.
- [Interlace Design System](https://ds.interlace.tools): Shadcn registry of 146 React components with published contracts: RSC boundary, min viewport, keyboard path, semver.
- [More Shadcn](https://more-shadcn.noair.fun): 43 copy-paste Svelte 5 components extending shadcn-svelte — audio, calendar, dock, stepper and more.
- [neobrutalism-vue](https://github.com/michaelsieminski/neobrutalism-vue): 38 neobrutalist Vue components for Tailwind v4, installed from a shadcn-vue registry.
- [registry.directory](https://github.com/rbadillap/registry.directory): A directory indexing 91 public shadcn/ui registries and ~27,000 components, installable with the shadcn CLI.
- [Tailark](https://tailark.com): Shadcn registry of marketing blocks, page sections and illustrations for building marketing websites.
- [unDraw CN](https://undraw-cn.vaatun.com): shadcn registry of all 1,362 unDraw illustrations as customizable, typed React components.
- [WA UI](https://ui.meta-cloud-api.site): shadcn/ui registry of WhatsApp Web chat components built on WhatsApp's WDS design tokens.
- [hookagain](https://github.com/ilyichv/hookagain): Collection of reusable React hooks installable with the shadcn CLI.
- [Shoogle](https://shoogle.dev): Search engine for shadcn UI components, blocks and templates across community registries, with an MCP server for agents.
- [Ritesh Bucha](https://bucharitesh.in): Personal site that doubles as a shadcn registry of 26 craft components for Next.js apps.
- [Chánh Đại](https://chanhdai.com): Design engineer's portfolio with a shadcn registry of 42 components and 12 blocks for React and Next.js.
- [Shadcn Storybook Registry](https://registry.lloydrichards.dev): Installable Storybook stories for shadcn/ui components: 68 stories across Radix UI and Base UI registries.
